
==  morphology ==

Xorxes' morphology rules:

* [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-index.php?page=BPFK+Section%3A+PEG+Morphology+Algorithm&amp;bl]

==  camxes ==

Robin's PEG grammar and morphology rules:

* [http://www.digitalkingdom.org/~rlpowell/hobbies/lojban/grammar/index.html amxes]
* [http://www.digitalkingdom.org/~rlpowell/hobbies/lojban/grammar/lojban.peg.txt ojban_peg.txt]

* [http://www.digitalkingdom.org/~rlpowell/hobbies/lojban/grammar/l lojban_morphology.peg.txt]

==  jbominje ==

John Leuner's PEG grammar is a combination of Robin's peg grammar and Xorxes' morphology rules:

* [http://subvert-the-dominant-paradigm.net/~jbominji/code/l lojban_grammar.peg]

==  jbogenturfa'i ==

[[.alyn.post.|.alyn.post.]]'s PEG grammar is derived from camxes:

* [http://bugs.call-cc.org/browser/release/4/jbogenturfahi/trunk/r rafske.peg]
* [http://bugs.call-cc.org/browser/release/4/jbogenturfahi/trunk/g gerna.peg]

This grammar is used by [http://wiki.call-cc.org/eggref/4/jbogenturfahi bogenturfa'i], a Lojban grammar parser written in Scheme.
